sentences.text: 2. Issue notice to the respondent, returnable on 28.01.2020.
Learned APP waives notice for the respondent.

3. Till next date, in the event of arrest in connection with Crime No.181 of 2019 registered with Police Station, Purna, Dist. Parbhani, for the offences punishable under Sections 328, 272, 273, 188 and 120-B of Indian Penal Code and Sections 26(2)(6), 27(2)(e), 2 3-ABA.50-20 30(2)(a) and 59(6)
of Food Safety and Standards Act, the applicant be released on executing P.R. Bond in the sum of Rs.15,000/- (Rupees Fifteen Thousand) with one surety in the like amount.
4. The applicant shall attend the concerned Police Station as and when required by the Investigating Officer.
